  • For someone who's never even heard of boxing, that was a pretty good right-fake/left-hook combo.

  • Kelly's closing statement about the female author was incredibly smug.

  • Forced sex change (TNG 5x17 "The Outcast")

  • Gordon should have been monitored by a Moclan lie detector, in order to verify his testimony.

 

Unanswered Questions:

  • Was the trial kept completely secret? If word of the trial got out, wouldn't Bortus' child be ridiculed anyway since everybody knows he was born a she? What about that female writer hiding in the mountains? Is her secret out now? How will this affect the Moclan society on a whole?

 

Anything Else:

  • The joke about Rodolph's father wanting to euthanize him may be my favorite in the entire series.

 

SJW cringe level: Manageable
